title: We worship none but Him
cue: What Ibn al-Zubayr said after each prayer and traced to the Prophet ﷺ
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ، وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer, laa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaah, laa ilaha illallaah, walaa na'budu illaa iyyaah, lahun-ni'matu walahul-fadl, walahuth-thanaa'ul-hasan, laa ilaha illallaahu mukhliseena lahud-deena walaw karihal-kaafiroon
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no power and no strength except through Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the blessing, His the bounty, and His the beautiful praise. There is no god but Allah; we are sincere to Him in religion, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 594: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1284

when: After each prayer, once the salam is said
usage.evidence: Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr said this after every prayer when he gave the salam, and said the Prophet ﷺ used to declare these words after every prayer (Muslim 594).
